name: org.getopenhealth/openhealth
title: OpenHealth
description: Public US doctor and hospital records: procedure scores, insurer listings, ratings and prices.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Lists the procedures covered by OpenHealth, such as knee replacement, hip replacement, heart bypass and cataract surgery, with each procedure's id and OpenHealth page. Shows which procedures have doctor ratings and which do not. Use it to find the procedure id for a doctor search. This tool takes no input.

tools.name: find_doctors_for_procedure
tools.description: Finds rated doctors for a procedure near a US city or ZIP code, for example a knee replacement surgeon near me. Returns up to 5 doctors in OpenHealth's published order: predicted result at the doctor's affiliated hospitals, then procedures a year, then distance. Each doctor has a letter grade, a yearly procedure count, a distance and a main hospital. The grade describes the hospitals, not the doctor's own skill. Only some procedures have ratings. The others return not_scored with the reason. The radius is 10, 25 or 50 miles.

procedure.description: The procedure, as an id such as knee-replacement or in plain words such as knee replacement.

place.description: A US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a 5-digit ZIP code.

radius_miles.description: The search radius in miles: 10, 25 or 50. The default is 25.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Searches OpenHealth's public records for a doctor or hospital by name. Returns up to 10 matches with the doctor's NPI or the hospital's CCN, the city, the state and the OpenHealth page. A hospital search needs a two-letter state. A doctor search can be narrowed by state. When no doctor has the exact name, it returns doctors with similar names and marks them.

name.description: The doctor's or hospital's name, such as Matthew Bernhard or Riverside Methodist.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.

kind.description: doctor or hospital. The default is doctor.

tools.name: get_doctor
tools.description: Gets one doctor's public record by 10-digit NPI. The record lists offices, specialties, ratings for each scored procedure and the reasons for those ratings, affiliated hospitals, federal exclusion-list checks, state medical board actions matched by license number in states OpenHealth covers, and published procedure counts and outcome measures with their sources. Each rating predicts results at the doctor's affiliated hospitals. OpenHealth gives no overall doctor score.

tools.name: check_doctor_insurance
tools.description: Checks which insurance plan directories list a doctor, by NPI or by name with an optional state, and optionally for one insurer such as Aetna, Cigna or Medicare. Returns each listing with its plans, its update date and whether the directory lists the doctor as accepting new patients, plus Medicare and Medicaid billing. No listing means unknown, not out of network. A listing does not confirm coverage. Only the plan can confirm it.

doctor_name.description: The doctor's full name, such as Matthew Bernhard. Use it when you have no NPI.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.

insurer.description: One insurer to check, using one of the listed ids, such as aetna or medicare.

tools.name: get_hospital
tools.description: Gets one hospital's public record by CCN, or by name with a two-letter state. The record includes the address, CMS overall star rating, hospital type, owners from CMS ownership records, private equity flag, last ownership change, published outcome measures, and whether OpenHealth holds a current price file for the hospital.

ccn.description: The hospital's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 360006.

name.description: The hospital's name, such as Riverside Methodist Hospital. Use it with state when you have no CCN.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH. A hospital name needs this code.

tools.name: get_hospital_prices
tools.description: Gets a hospital's published price for a service, such as a head CT, chest X-ray, knee MRI, colonoscopy or knee replacement, or for a CPT code. Takes the hospital's CCN, or its name with a two-letter state, and an optional insurer. Returns the cash price and insurer rates as published in the hospital's own price file, with the file and its read date. A price is not a personal quote, is not checked against a plan network and is not the total cost of care. OpenHealth does not show a file read more than 30 days ago.

ccn.description: The hospital's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 360006.

hospital.description: The hospital's name, such as Riverside Methodist Hospital. Use it with state when you have no CCN.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH. A hospital name needs this code.

service.description: The service or procedure, as one of the listed ids, such as head-ct-without-contrast or knee-replacement.

cpt_code.description: A five-character CPT or HCPCS code, such as 70450. Use it when no service id fits.

insurer.description: One insurer to check, using one of the listed ids, such as aetna or medicare.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Lists the public data sources behind OpenHealth's doctor and hospital records, such as CMS files and state reports, with each source's link and review date, and the current data release.

tools.name: find_nursing_homes
tools.description: Finds Medicare-certified nursing homes by name, by place, or both. The place can be a city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, a 5-digit ZIP code or a two-letter state. Returns up to 10 homes ordered by Medicare's overall star rating, then by name, with each home's CCN, city, beds, nurse hours, fines and owner type. When no home lists the ZIP code, it returns homes whose ZIP codes share the first three digits and says so. OpenHealth does not grade nursing homes.

name.description: Part of the nursing home's name, such as Burns Nursing Home.

place.description: A US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, a 5-digit ZIP code, or a two-letter state code.

tools.name: get_nursing_home
tools.description: Gets one nursing home's Medicare record by its six-character CCN. The record includes Medicare's star ratings, staffing hours and turnover, the latest inspection summary and citations, fines and payment denials, owners and ownership changes, the chain, and the Special Focus Facility and abuse flags, with the source files and their dates. The ratings are Medicare's. OpenHealth adds no grade of its own.

ccn.description: The nursing home's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 015009.

tools.name: get_doctor_payments
tools.description: Gets the general payments that drug and device companies reported to CMS Open Payments for one doctor, by 10-digit NPI. Returns totals by program year and by company, with the payment types, and the doctor's Medicare Part D prescriptions of drugs named in those payments where the files have them. A payment is not a sign of wrongdoing. The overlap with prescriptions does not show that a payment changed a prescription.

tools.name: search_drugs
tools.description: Searches drugs by brand or generic name, such as metformin or Eliquis. Returns up to 10 matches with each drug's RxCUI, its name and form, whether it is a brand or a generic, and how many marketplace plan drug lists name it. Use the RxCUI with get_drug.

name.description: The drug's brand or generic name, such as metformin or Eliquis.

tools.name: get_drug
tools.description: Gets the public figures for one drug by RxCUI: NADAC, which is what pharmacies pay to buy the drug and not a retail price, Medicare Part D spending, state Medicaid spending by year, and how many marketplace plan drug lists name the drug, with their tiers and limits. None of these figures is what a person pays at the pharmacy. A plan list that does not name the drug is unknown, not a sign that the plan does not cover it.

rxcui.description: The drug's RxNorm concept ID (RxCUI), such as 861004. search_drugs returns it.

tools.name: find_health_plans
tools.description: Finds marketplace health plans in a state for a plan year, optionally narrowed by plan name, insurer or plan ID. Returns up to 20 plans ordered by deductible, low to high, then by name, as the site lists them, with each plan's ID, metal level, insurer, deductible and out-of-pocket maximum as the CMS file states them, and its drug list size. Premiums are not in the public file. The amounts are not a quote for you.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.

query.description: Words from the plan name or the insurer name, or a plan ID.

year.description: The plan year, such as 2027. The default is the latest year OpenHealth reads.

tools.name: get_health_plan
tools.description: Gets one marketplace health plan by its 14-character plan ID and plan year. Returns the metal level, plan type, insurer, deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums as the CMS file states them, the drug list counts by tier with prior approval, step therapy and quantity limit counts, the size of the insurer's directory for the plan, and links to the plan documents. The amounts are not a quote for you.

plan_id.description: The 14-character plan ID from the plan documents, such as 31274WV0560001.

year.description: The plan year, such as 2027. The default is the latest year OpenHealth reads.
